description: The agent-harness feature-flag matrix (F3). One source of truth: docs/agent-harness-v2/FLAGS.md renders it, C-16 (Python tests/cohesion/test_c16_flag_matrix.py, Node tests/cohesion/c16-flag-matrix.test.ts) keeps it equal to the code and the deployment files, and the behaviour tests read their expected defaults and reasons from it. 'default' is what the code does when the flag is absent; 'shipped' is what each operator-facing file sets (null: not set, the code default applies). Reader paths are relative to the repository root.

flags.name: CONTROL_PLANE_POLICY_STORE

flags.notes: Read once per process in both languages. Python decides in one function, policy_documents() (app/harness/policy_documents.py; cohesion C-31 holds every KV policy read behind it). Deleted with the flip release's deletions (impl/CPD-4-policy-store.md §4).

flags.name: HARNESS_CONTEXT_COMPILER
flags.parse: env_flag: 1/true/yes/on or 0/false/no/off, any case; unset or blank: the default; any other value refuses to start (InvalidEnvFlag / InvalidEnvFlagError / the entrypoint exits, naming the flag)
flags.changedBy: operator (the durable worker's environment)
flags.gates: the context compiler on durable loop runs (P4.1/P4.2): each request compiled from the journal in fixed cache bands (sorted, append-only tools; volatile content in the tail; other principals' and external content quoted), and the reduction ladder on the provider's usage (context.cleared above 50% of the window, context.compacted through a metered summarising call above 80%); off: requests are assembled by the turn shaper as before (byte-equal)
flags.notes: Off by default until P4.5 retires the legacy shapers it bypasses and recorded model runs show no regression (P4.6).

flags.name: HARNESS_AUTO_COMPACT
flags.parse: env_flag: 1/true/yes/on or 0/false/no/off, any case; unset or blank: the default; any other value refuses to start (InvalidEnvFlag / InvalidEnvFlagError / the entrypoint exits, naming the flag)
flags.changedBy: operator (the durable worker's environment; the off switch)
flags.gates: the reduction ladder's compact rung on durable loop runs whose requests are shaped (HARNESS_CONTEXT_COMPILER off, LC2FIX-2): when the provider counts a request above 80% of the model's window, everything before the last three replies is summarised through a metered call and journaled as context.compacted before the next request, which the shaped history then applies; no clearing rung, and below 80% requests are unchanged. With HARNESS_CONTEXT_COMPILER on, its own ladder applies; off: a shaped request is never reduced on its own (the person's /compact still is)
flags.notes: On by default (LC2FIX-2): a long durable chat never runs past its window. Kept apart from HARNESS_CONTEXT_COMPILER, whose cache-band layout stays off by P4.18's pre-registered cost rule.

flags.name: HARNESS_DEEP_ROUTING

Off: code_task is still offered for the model to choose, nothing hands off on its own
flags.notes: On by default: deep work goes to the coding agent. Nothing routes where no engine is admitted (none enabled, gVisor floor not met, the person chose none): admission does not pin x.pipeshub.codeTask.

settings.name: AGENT_HARNESS_CLAIM_FLOOR_EVERY

settings.name: AGENT_HARNESS_PREEMPT_OVERCOMMIT

settings.name: AGENT_HARNESS_PREEMPT_MIN_SLICE_S

settings.name: PIPESHUB_PROMPT_CACHE_TTL

settings.name: PIPESHUB_PROMPT_CACHE_RETENTION

settings.name: EGRESS_PRIVATE_ALLOW

settings.name: EGRESS_VOLUME_ALERT_UP_MB

settings.name: EGRESS_VOLUME_ALERT_DOWN_MB
settings.reason: tuning (C6.12): the same alert when a run's sandboxes have received more than this many MiB from outside destinations (the gateways not counted) (default 2048; 0 off; malformed: the egress proxy does not start)

settings.name: EGRESS_VOLUME_BASELINE_FACTOR
settings.reason: tuning (C6.12): the egress proxy journals egress.volume_alert (org_baseline) when a run sends more than this many times its org's usual run to outside destinations (the gateways not counted, in the run or the baseline), the mean of the org's ended runs, then from its 50th a moving average that gives each new run a weight of 1/50 (default 10; 0 off; otherwise at least 1; malformed: the egress proxy does not start)

settings.name: EGRESS_VOLUME_BASELINE_MIN_RUNS
settings.reason: tuning (C6.12): how many ended runs an org needs before its baseline alert is armed (default 20; 0 arms it from the first ended run, as 1 does; malformed: the egress proxy does not start)

settings.name: EGRESS_VOLUME_BASELINE_FLOOR_MB
settings.reason: tuning (C6.12): the org-baseline alert never fires below this many MiB sent (default 32; malformed: the egress proxy does not start)

settings.name: EGRESS_RUN_MAX_MB
settings.reason: limit (C6.12): the hard cap on what one run's sandboxes move (a sandbox kept for a conversation counts toward the run it serves now) through the egress proxy to outside destinations only (tunnels, intercepted TLS, databases, any other host); PipesHub's Model and Tool Gateways are counted for the metrics only (WP-61), up and down together, in MiB (default 0: no cap); past it the run's outside streams and tunnels are cut, every new outside request is refused volume_cap_exceeded and egress.volume_alert (run_cap) is journaled, a model stream in flight finishes, and the run's next Model Gateway call is refused egress_volume_exceeded so the engine ends the run with that code, which the chat words; a malformed value stops the egress proxy at start

settings.reason: tuning: the most the repository cache holds, in MB (default 2048); past it the least recently used fetches are removed

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_CACHE_MIN_FREE_MB
settings.reason: tuning: the free disk, in MB, a repository_fetch must leave on the cache's volume; unset: 5% of the volume, at least 2048 and at most 20480; a clone that would leave less is refused, and the Git hosts screen warns below twice it

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_MAX_MB
settings.reason: tuning: the most one repository_fetch may bring, in MB (default 500); a clone past it is killed and nothing is kept

settings.name: HARNESS_INPUT_MAX_MB
settings.reason: limit (J-26): the largest file a run is given as an input, in MiB (default 100), and so the largest artifact the registry keeps and the largest object Node's internal storage upload takes; an org's sandbox.inputMaxMb lowers it, never raises it; inputs over 8 MiB reach the sandbox only on their first read; not a positive whole number refuses to start

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_FETCH_CONCURRENCY
settings.reason: tuning: how many repository fetches one worker runs at once (default 2); the rest wait

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_FETCH_TIMEOUT_S
settings.reason: tuning: how long one repository fetch may take, in seconds (default 300); past it the clone is killed

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_CACHE_MAX_AGE_S
settings.reason: tuning: how long a fetched repository is reused for the same org, URL, ref and depth before it is fetched again, in seconds (default 600; 0: always fetch)

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_GIT_BIN
settings.reason: security: the pinned git binary repository_fetch runs (default /usr/bin/git; git 2.37 or newer, for http.curloptResolve)

settings.name: HARNESS_REPO_CA_FILE
settings.reason: security: an authority bundle git checks the git host's certificate with instead of the system's (an internal mirror with its own authority); unset: the system's

settings.name: PIPESHUB_SKILLS_CATALOG_RENDER_LIMIT
settings.reason: tuning: how many skills the prompt's skill catalog lists (default 40)

settings.name: PIPESHUB_SKILLS_PRELOAD_BODY_THRESHOLD
settings.reason: tuning: the similarity at which a skill's body is preloaded into a run (default 0.75)

settings.name: PIPESHUB_SKILLS_PRELOAD_MENTION_THRESHOLD
settings.reason: tuning: the similarity at which a skill is mentioned to a run (default 0.4)

settings.name: PIPESHUB_SKILLS_MAX_RESOURCE_FILE_BYTES
settings.reason: limit: the largest resource file a skill may bundle (default 1 MiB)

settings.name: PIPESHUB_SKILLS_MAX_RESOURCE_BYTES
settings.reason: limit: all of a skill's bundled resources together (default 5 MiB)

settings.name: PIPESHUB_SKILL_VECTOR_CACHE_SIZE
settings.reason: tuning: how many skill embeddings the process caches (default 4096)

settings.name: HARNESS_MODEL_OUTPUT_LIMIT
settings.reason: tuning: tokens one model call may produce (P4.17): agent turns and engine calls through the model gateway (default 32768; structured calls and summaries 8192 under it), also the switch for the repetition cut; 0: no limit sent and no cut (the provider's own maximum, as before); 1-4095 reads as 4096

settings.name: HARNESS_DEEP_ROUTING_THRESHOLDS
settings.reason: tuning: when a durable loop run that may hand off has outgrown a chat reply (DEEPROUTE), as toolCalls=12,turns=6,contextShare=0.5,spendShare=0.3 (the defaults; a key left out keeps its default, 0 turns that one off; one the worker cannot read is logged and the defaults apply)

settings.name: HARNESS_HTTP_HEADER_TIMEOUT_S
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): seconds a client of a Python harness listener (tool gateway, model gateway, egress proxy, sandbox broker) has to send a request head, from its first byte or from connecting (default 15)

settings.name: HARNESS_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): seconds a client of a Python harness listener has to send a whole request, plus the time its bytes take at HARNESS_HTTP_MIN_BODY_BYTES_PER_S; a response is never timed (default 60)

settings.name: HARNESS_HTTP_MIN_BODY_BYTES_PER_S
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): the rate at which a request body earns time past HARNESS_HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_S, so a large upload at speed is never cut and a drip is (default 65536)

settings.name: HARNESS_HTTP_MAX_CONNECTIONS
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): connections one Python harness listener holds at once; past it a new one is closed on arrival (default 4096)

settings.name: HARNESS_ARCHIVE_MAX_RATIO
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-FS-03): how many times its own size an archive the harness unpacks may expand to, past HARNESS_ARCHIVE_RATIO_FLOOR_BYTES (snapshots, sandbox folders, collected outputs, pushed packs; default 100)

settings.name: HARNESS_ARCHIVE_RATIO_FLOOR_BYTES
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-FS-03): the bytes an archive may expand to before HARNESS_ARCHIVE_MAX_RATIO applies (default 67108864, the snapshot capture cap)

settings.name: HARNESS_ARCHIVE_MAX_MEMBERS
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-FS-03): members an archive the harness reads whole may hold (snapshots, sandbox folders, a pushed pack's objects; default 50000; the workspace sync keeps its own 50000)

settings.name: AGENT_HARNESS_INTERNAL_HEADERS_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): milliseconds a client of Node's internal listener has to send a request head (default 15000)

settings.name: AGENT_HARNESS_INTERNAL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): milliseconds a client of Node's internal listener has to send a whole request; a response is never timed (default 60000)

settings.name: AGENT_HARNESS_INTERNAL_MAX_CONNECTIONS
settings.reason: tuning (C6.40, SEC-DOS-04): connections Node's internal listener holds at once (default 1024)
